node.title: Pay nonconstant-pencil penultimate and maximal-pencil source classes
node.statement: For the original generic-regular KoalaBear rank12/P2-rank19 source on J9965..21499, outside the previously paid whole-source pencil alternatives, every seven-anchor5/4 enclosure with a nonconstant pencil plane and nu<=H=floor((J1-1)/10) fits1048577*L_t/(67473-t). Any j-anchor prefix with a maximal nonconstant pencil of dimension s-1, s=11-j, fits the full remaining-anchor L_t price without a normalization cap. Therefore an original regular rank19 source with a nonconstant10-dimensional pencil is paid by272127061148955779, including the smaller paid whole-source alternatives by maximum. Combined residual small-normalization penultimate survivors have constant-direction planes but no nonconstant plane; high-normalization image3..9 survivors have no nonconstant3 pencil. No unrestricted rank19, whole J, row or Prize closes.
